title: Read the Paper, Write the Code: Agentic Reproduction of Social-Science Results
abstract: arXiv:2604.21965v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work has used LLM agents to reproduce empirical social science results with access to both the data and code. We broaden this scope by asking: Can they reproduce results given only a paper's methods description and original data? We develop an agentic reproduction system that extracts structured methods descriptions from papers, runs reimplementations under strict information isolation -- agents never see the original code, results, or paper -- and enables deterministic, cell-level comparison of reproduced outputs to the original results. An error attribution step traces discrepancies through the system chain to identify root causes. Evaluating four agent scaffolds and four LLMs on 48 papers with human-verified reproducibility, we find that agents can largely recover published results, but performance varies substantially between models, scaffolds, and papers. translated_title: 阅读论文，编写代码：社会科学结果的智能体重现
translated_abstract: 近期的工作已使用LLM智能体在同时拥有数据和代码的条件下重现实证社会科学结果。我们拓宽了这一范围，提出问题：如果智能体只能获取论文的方法描述和原始数据，它们能否重现结果？我们开发了一个智能体重现系统，该系统从论文中提取结构化的方法描述，在严格的信息隔离下运行重新实现——智能体从不接触原始代码、结果或论文——并支持将重现输出与原始结果进行确定性的单元格级比较。一个错误归因步骤通过系统链追踪差异以识别根本原因。在48篇经人工验证可重现性的论文上，对四种智能体框架和四个LLM进行评估后发现，智能体能够在很大程度上恢复已发表的结果，但性能在模型、框架和论文之间存在显著差异。根本原因分析显示，失败既源于智能体自身的错误……
tldr: 本研究开发了一个信息隔离的智能体重现系统，让LLM智能体仅凭论文的方法描述和原始数据重现社会科学研究结果，发现智能体能大体恢复已发表结果，但性能在模型、框架和论文间差异显著，并通过错误归因分析定位失败根因。
en_tdlr: This work develops an information-isolated agentic reproduction system enabling LLM agents to reproduce social-science results from only a paper's methods description and raw data, showing agents can largely recover published results—though performance varies substantially across models, scaffolds, and papers—with error attribution tracing failures to their root causes.
